Hon'ble Umesh Chandra Sharma,J.
1.
Heard Sri Dinesh Kumar Kashyap, learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State-opposite party and perused the record.

2. The instant bail application, under Section 439 Cr.P.C, has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 422 of 2021, under Sections 307, 420, 413 I.P.C. Police Station- Friends Colony, District Etawah, during the pendency of trial.

entities.text: I.P.C. Police Station- Friends Colony, District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
Learned counsel has explained criminal history of the applicant in para 16 of the affidavit.
No injury has been received by the Police personnel.
Learned counsel for the applicant has further contended that only to show good, the Police has concocted the story and lodged this false F.I.R.

It is next contended that the co-accused Jagat Narayan Mishra, having identical role, has been granted bail by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 28406 of 2022 vide order dated 11.07.2022.

The applicant claims parity.

4. Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.
5. Having regard to the submissions made but without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
